best_for: Social media managers, small business owners and teachers who already design in Canva's website and want it in its own window on Windows or Mac.

points.title: The same Canva in an app window
points.text: The desktop app puts Canva's design tool in its own window on Windows and Mac. It is the same service as the website, with apps also offered for iOS, Android and Chromebook.

points.title: Free to download, paid plans exist
points.text: The app costs nothing, and Canva sells Pro, Business, Enterprise, Education and Nonprofit plans on top of the free one. We could not read the pricing page, so check canva.com/pricing for current prices.

points.title: Windows 10 or later
points.text: Canva's download page lists Windows 10 and later. The installer here is x64 and installs for the current user, so no admin rights are needed.

points.title: Intel and Apple silicon Macs
points.text: The Mac app runs on Macs with Intel and Apple chips. The build listed here needs macOS 13 or later.

points.title: No Linux app
points.text: Canva lists no Linux app on its download pages, so Linux users have to work in the browser.

points.title: Versions kept
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 74 versions; macOS lists only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
